description.value: YL's Curry Bowl is a Malaysian-style fast-food stall specializing in authentic Penang-inspired curry, Hainanese chicken, and laksa noodles, located inside the Surrey Guildford T&T Supermarket Food Court. The kitchen uses premium ingredients including A-grade beef brisket and New Zealand lamb, with everything made fresh daily. For a touring cyclist in the Surrey area, it offers a filling, flavourful hot meal in a covered, climate-controlled setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms business name, phone (604-930-1155), and address (101E - 15277 100th Ave, Surrey, BC V3R 8X2) — notably the actual location is inside the Surrey Guildford T&T Supermarket Food Court, not North Vancouver as the OSM community tag states; coordinates (49.1847, -122.799) are consistent with Surrey, not North Vancouver. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website; takeout and online ordering are confirmed. OSM cuisine tag 'chinese' contradicts the website, which clearly identifies this as Malaysian/Hainanese cuisine.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'North Vancouver' but actual address per website is 101E - 15277 100th Ave, Surrey, BC V3R 8X2 — a different municipality entirely. Coordinates are consistent with Surrey, not North Vancouver.
OSM cuisine tag is 'chinese' but the business serves Malaysian/Hainanese cuisine; the website makes no claim of Chinese cuisine.

This is a food court stall inside a supermarket, not a standalone restaurant — bike parking and washroom availability depend on the host T&T Supermarket facility, which is not described on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM record assigns this business to 'North Vancouver' but the website and coordinates confirm it is in Surrey (Guildford T&T Food Court). The record should be re-assigned to the Surrey community before inclusion; no cycling-specific amenities could be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.notes: Bike parking, washroom access, and water refill are likely determined by the host T&T Supermarket facility rather than the stall itself; a site visit or T&T Guildford store inquiry would resolve these.

Takeout.detail: Online ordering available; family combos are pick-up only. Walk-in ordering at the food court stall also available
